ui.2339: Diagram: a RAG pipeline in five steps. Split documents into chunks; embed them as vectors; store them in a vector database; retrieve the best passages; prompt the model to answer from them, with citations. Regression checks run on every change.
ui.2340: The pipeline this section describes, in order.
ui.2341: Diagram: three layers. One, the ML platform: pipelines that train, test, register and deploy models. Two, AI infrastructure: operating GPU clusters. Three, inference and GPU performance: making trained models serve faster and cheaper.
ui.2342: The three layers named in this section.
ui.2343: Diagram: a star schema. A central fact table of events is joined to three dimension tables: product, store and date.
ui.2344: Why it is called a star: one fact table, dimensions around it.
ui.2345: Diagram: three SOC tiers. Tier 1 reviews alerts and closes false positives; Tier 2 investigates escalations and isolates hosts; Tier 3 hunts proactively and writes detection rules, which feed back into the alert queue.
ui.2346: How an alert moves through the tiers, and what comes back.

ui.2348: The control this section’s audit tests.

ui.2350: One test, repeated across the sample.
